track.title: Shur
track.notes: Same audio as 'Ahmad Ebadi, Setar Solo' (2000), CD1 track 1 (Shur), sample-aligned; that release is not analysed separately.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on G3 and dwells most on G in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:20.2) introduces F, centred on C. Phrase 6 (0:44.7) introduces G, centred on G. Phrase 9 (3:52.1) introduces Ak, centred on Ak. Phrase 10 (4:03.7) introduces Bb, centred on Ak. Phrase 29 (8:42.2) introduces Dk, centred on C. Phrase 31 (9:07.8) introduces Eb, centred on C. The line peaks at C5 (531.1 Hz) at 4:12.9. It closes on the tonic (D4 → D4 → D4 → C4 → G3 → G3).

theory_fit.name: Vaziri 24-tone equal temperament
theory_fit.description: Quarter-tone grid (koron/sori = exactly 50 ¢ from the natural note).

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din
theory_fit.description: Nearest note of the 17-note gamut generated by pure fifths (±8) from the tonic.
